files.reason: When -Dcorex=true, route .cu compilation through scripts/corex_nvcc_wrapper.sh (clang++ -x ivcore) instead of nvcc, which the CoreX SDK does not ship.
Add boolean option 'corex' (default false) to enable the CoreX clang++ CUDA path without affecting upstream/NVIDIA builds.
Bypass '#if __CUDA_ARCH__ >= 530' / '< 530' arch gates via __ILUVATAR__ so real fp16 kernel bodies compile on ivcore11 (device __CUDA_ARCH__ reports 300).
New nvcc-compatible wrapper: answers meson -h/--dryrun probes and translates nvcc-style flags to clang++ -x ivcore --cuda-gpu-arch=ivcore11, dropping nvcc-only flags.
